options.name: Precision Cut
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original logo concept for FrameIQ, a professional desktop app for extracting precise frames from video and AI-assisted visual inspection.
Presentation: a single polished logo on a plain warm-white background, square canvas. One large centered standalone emblem above a smaller wordmark. Generous clean margins. The emblem must have a strong silhouette and remain clear at 24 pixels.
Style: crisp, minimal flat vector-like graphic design; balanced negative space; confidently drawn geometry. Use the app's existing graphite (#1b1b1b) and Fluent blue (#0f6cbd), with white negative space.
Text, verbatim, exactly once: "FrameIQ". Preserve capitalization F-r-a-m-e-I-Q. Clean contemporary semibold sans-serif wordmark, optically spaced, graphite.
Avoid: mockups, devices, 3D, gradients, shadows, textures, watermarks, captions, option numbers, decorative flourishes, AI brains/circuits, generic play-button triangles, and extra text. Produce one complete logo, not a grid of variations.
Distinct design direction: A bold square frame symbol with one precise interruption: its upper-right corner becomes a detached small blue square, like a single frame selected and extracted. Build the main frame from substantial graphite bands with an intelligently offset blue segment. Architectural, compact, precise. Create a memorable silhouette with very few parts. The detached square must belong to the frame composition rather than resemble a notification badge.
